intro.text: Hallandren's god of healing, a blunt-spoken Returned who plays Tarachin every week with Lightsong, Weatherlove and Truthcall.

items.text: For the gods at the weekly Tarachin game, politics is the real contest, but Lifeblesser often misses what is being implied and is baffled by Lightsong's jokes. He says plainly that he thinks Siri is only acting innocent, and proposes attacking Idris to punish Dedelin for sending his youngest daughter in place of Vivenna.

appearance.text: Almost seven feet tall, with a sculpted build and square jaw like many gods. He has brown hair and wears flowing robes in his colours, blue and silver.

personality.text: Honest but not especially clever, he tends to say whatever crosses his mind, which makes the finer points of court politics hard for him and sometimes makes his friends wince.
